description: This PHP file defines the class TemplateBoolean, which extends TemplateField. It provides methods to generate template variables for rendering boolean field widgets in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including functions for editing, searching, detailing, and listing views.

classes.name: TemplateBoolean
classes.description: A class for handling boolean (checkbox) fields in SuiteCRM templates, providing methods for rendering different views.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for editing a boolean field, including handling default and current values, as well as help text.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Generates template variables for searching a boolean field based on request input.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Prepares template variables for displaying a boolean field in detail view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same template variables as 'get_xtpl_edit' for list view.
